item.title: Parents: As Students Head Back to School, Teach Them About the Dangers of Tobacco
item.description: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE- August 20, 2025JACKSON, Miss. – As students return to school and spend more time with peers, it’s important to remind them of the dangers of smoking. Tobacco use usually starts during adolescence; in fact, 90% of adults who smoke cigarettes began the habit by the age of 18, according to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC). item.description: By Susan Collins-Smith, MSU Extension Service PICAYUNE, Miss. -- Nature enthusiasts, school groups and the public can learn more about the wonderful world of insects during “BugFest 2025 -- BeetleMania!” in Picayune.
